correctness.rationale: Complete direct proof: right module uniseriality gives unique Peirce row thresholds; arrow multiplication yields necessary and sufficient cyclic admissibility. Each ordered product minimizes a+u_(i+a) at its first admissible a because u decreases by at most one per step. The transfer trace counts every ideal by dimension. The profile shift and Catalan zero-gap logarithmic generating function prove stabilization at the claimed threshold and central-binomial slope; a nondegenerate Frobenius pairing proves reciprocity. Independently constructed F2 multiplication tables, all 5733 ambient subspaces across four cases, 489 ordered products, and additional combinatorial tests match the formulas. Finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Two-sided ideals, their ordered products, annihilation and dimensions are natural structural invariants for truncated cyclic Nakayama algebras. The theorem gives a complete field-independent ideal monoid across two free structural parameters; the dimension trace is exact, and the eventual linear Loewy growth with slope binom(2n-1,n-1) has a nontrivial Catalan decomposition. These facts distinguish the behavior of the full ideal lattice from generic field-dependent subspace counts and are not merely a small numerical gain.
